name: sliding-number
title: Sliding Number
description: A number whose digits each slide on their own spring reel to the next value in a list, shortest way round, with places appearing and disappearing as the length changes.
useWhen: A figure (price, count, score) changes value on screen and each digit should visibly slide to its new place.
Values of different lengths follow one another and the number should grow or shrink gracefully.
avoidWhen: A smooth run-up from zero to a target: use number-wheel or rolling-number.
Characters other than digits are changing: use slot-machine-roll.
author: ibelick

variables.label: Values
variables.description: Whole numbers separated by commas; the number slides from one to the next.

variables.description: Seconds from one change to the next.
